documentation: Proxmox Backup documentation page Backup Client Usage (its title read Proxmox Backup 4.2.8-1 documentation) for the command and its --output-format option, which that page does not show for this command; the fields of an item from the Proxmox Backup source, pbs-api-types SnapshotListItem (git.proxmox.com, master), whose BackupDir part is flattened and is taken to carry backup-type, backup-id and backup-time as the snapshot manifest names them; retrieved 2026-11-03
export: proxmox-backup-client snapshot list --output-format json: a JSON array with one object per snapshot
name: proxmox_backup_client_snapshot_list
note: A snapshot the datastore lists is a backup it holds: the event is labelled backup_end by this preset, and says nothing of whether the backup can be restored. The listing has no per-snapshot action or result, so the backup type stands for the action and the result stays unknown.
